open_questions: 805b414 and 805cefe read an entity pointer (decompiler local_2c, +0xc mask) from a frame slot that is never written in those functions; the entity-model branch (type 0x3ff) is therefore translated as not taken. Confirm the producer of that slot before calling the branch reachable.
tr->world_bounds (+0xb4) is dereferenced by 805ac12 and 805c738 but is not set by 805b414/805cefe in the decompiled code; confirm the caller that owns it.

Area_LinkEntity and Area_LinkIntoSubtree write maxs at record +0x16c with three floats; maxs[2] lands on +0x174, the next record's header. Confirm the copy width of 0x805fba0 and whether the record stride or the maxs offset is off by one field.
Entity numbering in CM_AreaEntities uses (record index - 1) via the multiplicative inverse 0x3f4fd3f5 of 93; confirm with a link/unlink pair against a known entity.

Sweep_BuildSegment (shared prologue of 805b414 and 805cefe, not a separate Ghidra function) writes the larger z back into the end point's z slot as the decompiled frame indicates; confirm the frame layout before relying on the end z after the call.
